title: Robert Saleh on Calvin Ridley: Important to have players who can score from anywhere

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh on Calvin Ridley: Important to have players who can score from anywhere
sources.description: There was some question about whether wide receiver Calvin Ridley would be back with the Titans for the 2026 season, but he and the team worked out a revised contract this month that will keep him in Nashville.
